subject: ClearPay enablement — two-stage onboarding resync
messages:
From: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@clearpay.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: priya@clearpay.com
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — ClearPay onboarding

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is excited to get hands-on. We discussed a compact two-part onboarding (day 1 console walkthrough + day 2 API enablement/lab).

Availability on our side:
- Tue 19 Aug: morning (9–12 PT) or late afternoon (3–5 PT)
- Wed 20 Aug: flexible after 11:30 PT

We have 6 engineers (infrastructure + backend) and 2 product managers who should join the API session. Can you propose a 90–120 minute slot for each day? We prefer not to split attendees across more than two time blocks.

Also attaching a short list of integration questions our security team asked.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Principal Engineer, ClearPay
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@clearpay.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, priya@clearpay.com

Hi Alex — great to hear.

Thanks for the headcount and constraints. Proposed plan:
- Day 1 (Console walkthrough): 90 minutes — 2025-08-19 09:30–11:00 PT
  Agenda: console tour, keys & routing policies, live sandbox exercises, Q&A
- Day 2 (API enablement + hands-on lab): 120 minutes — 2025-08-20 13:00–15:00 PT
  Agenda: API auth, batching & KV caching best practices, integration patterns, live tokenized calls with your sample app

Attachments: Redwood_Console_API_Agenda_v2.pdf (detailed agenda), Access-Checklist_ClearPay.xlsx (prep items). Please confirm whether the proposed time blocks work and whether we should shift either day earlier to accommodate Europe-based PMs.

Prep ask: can your eng leads create sandbox service accounts and drop credentials in the shared Drive folder (link below) by EOD Monday? We'll run an initial access check 30 minutes before each session.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bClearPayOnboard
Calendar invite to follow once we lock times.

— Hannah
Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Rao <priya@clearpay.com>

Also, security wanted a short call about data retention questions before the console walkthrough — 15 minutes would suffice. Any chance you could squeeze a 15-minute pre-call at 09:15 PT on Aug 19?

Thanks —

- Aug 19 — 09:30–11:00 PT: Console walkthrough (as planned)
- Aug 20 — 11:00–13:00 PT: API enablement + lab (moved earlier for PM availability)
